desc: APL is the important exception in this domain, and the exception proves the mechanism. It is not an FFRDC: it is a University Affiliated Research Center, a distinct category established by the Department of Defense to preserve essential engineering and technical capability inside a university, without the FAR 35.017 sponsoring-agreement regime, the FFRDC funding ceilings, or the master-list registration that FFRDCs carry on the NSF's published inventory. Founded in 1942 to build the proximity fuze, APL has been the Navy's principal technical adviser ever since - strategic systems, missile defence, undersea warfare - and also runs major NASA missions. The distinction matters because the whistleblower record on legacy programmes is overwhelmingly Navy-centred: the UAP Task Force was Navy-led, the Nimitz and Roosevelt encounters were Navy, and the UAP Gerb allegations of August 2026 describe two Navy-spearheaded legacy programmes. A UARC is the one institutional form with FFRDC-like access and even less public registration. APL is catalogued here without any UAP claim attached; the point is that if the seam runs anywhere it runs at least as easily through a UARC as through an FFRDC, and no congressional letter has yet gone to one. That is a gap, not a finding.
